name: Bitrefill
description:
Bitrefill is a global catalog of gift cards, mobile top-ups, and eSIMs covering thousands of brands in 180+ countries: Amazon, Steam, Netflix, Spotify, Uber, Apple, Google Play, hundreds of mobile carriers, and travel data almost anywhere.

That reach makes it useful for far more than gifting:
- International gifting: send a present to someone in another country in seconds, with no shipping and no waiting.
- Send value home: top up a relative's phone or send them a grocery or shopping card directly, instead of a slow, fee-heavy transfer.
- Budgeting: set a fixed amount for a category or a family member by buying a card, rather than sharing an open account.
- Travel without the markup: buy local brand cards and eSIM data instead of paying foreign transaction fees on every swipe.
- Shop stores that will not take your card: buy that store's gift card and redeem it directly.
- Keep your card private: check out without handing your card number to every merchant.

Bitrefill has done this since 2014, with over 1 million customers. Pay with crypto or traditional payment methods, whichever you prefer. Once connected, Claude can search the catalog, compare options and prices, place an order, and return your gift card code or eSIM link right in the chat. Sign in once with your Bitrefill account, then just ask.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Bitrefill to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Bitrefill to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.bitrefill.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Bitrefill MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bitrefill provides these MCP tools: buy-products, get-invoice-by-id, get-product-details, list-invoices, search-products, submit-prepayment-step, and update-order.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Bitrefill?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Bitrefill in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Bitrefill requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Bitrefill is developed by Bitrefill. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
